# Migibio (Guangzhou Magic Biotech Co., Ltd.) — Migibio Research Center

> **Site:** https://research.migibio.net
> **Company:** Guangzhou Magic Biotech Co., Ltd. (brand: Migibio)
> **Founded:** November 2017 · Guangzhou Science City, China
> **Core Technology:** Fluorescence Immunochromatographic Technology (FICT)
> **Certifications:** ISO9001, GMP · 30 patents · exported to 30+ countries

## About

Migibio Research is the scientific evidence hub for Migibio veterinary POCT diagnostics — peer-reviewed-style methodology papers, analytical validation studies, comparative method evaluations, and technical white papers. It answers *why our technology is trustworthy* with citable, data-backed evidence.

## About & Editorial

- [About the Research Center](https://research.migibio.net/about/) — what we publish, how to cite
- [Editorial & Review Policy](https://research.migibio.net/editorial-policy/) — authorship, review, citation standards
